( n. ) the life of an ascetic mendicant; ? Sv 457, 8 (imāni ca cattāri disvā ~aṃ nāma sabbabodhisattānaṃ vaṃso va tanti yeva paveṇī yeva, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pabbajitabbaṃ); — pabbajitabhāvaṃ in Ee at Ja III 304, 16 is wr for pabbājitabhāvaṃ ( Be, Ce so; Se pabbājanīyabhāvaṃ); — neg. apabbajita, mfn. , Ja II 64, 27 (gehe jano kira maṃ apabbajitam eva pabbajito ti vatvā paridevati); Sp 1023, 14 ; Pj I 199, 9 (tena h’ āvuso pabbajāhi na sakkā apabbajitena sikkhitun ti); — supabbajita, mfn. , properly admitted; being a proper bhikkhu; Sp 1003, 6 ; Ps II 67, 26 ; — fpp pabbajitabba, ( mf ) n. , impers. , Sv 422, 2 (sabbabodhisattānaṃ hi ekasmiṃ kulavaṃsānurūpe putte jāte nikkhamitvā pabbajitabban ti); Mp I 344, 17 (agāramajjhe ca nāma arahattaṃ pattena taṃ divasam eva parinibbāyitabbaṃ vā pabbajitabbaṃ vā hoti); Thī-a 235, 11 (vuḍḍhāya bībhaccharūpāya vā pabbajitabban ti); — caus. ( a ) pr. 3 sg. pabbājeti , ~ayati , 1. makes (someone) live the homeless life of an ascetic; formally admits to the Buddhist saṅgha; Vin I 82, 17 (tena hi tvaṃ Sāriputta Rāhulakumāraṃ ~ehī ti); IV 226, 8 (kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo coriṃ ~essantī ti); D I 176, 19 (~enti upasampādenti); II 152, 29 (tena h’ Ānanda Subhaddaṃ ~ethā ti); Ap 485, 19 (~enti na maṃ keci jiṇṇaṃ); Mil 8, 16 (Nāgasenaṃ dārakaṃ nīharitvā ~ehi); Mhv 18:15 (~etuṃ); — 2. has (someone) admitted to the Buddhist saṅgha; Sp 51, 1 (yo hi koci … attano orasaṃ puttaṃ ~eti ayaṃ vuccati mahārāja dāyādo sāsanassā ti) ≠ Sv 615, 10 ; Dhp-a IV 215, 6 (taṃ dārakaṃ imaṃ therassa santike ~essāmī ti posesi); — 3. makes (someone) leave; sends away; banishes (from); expels; Vin III 45, 9 (kittakena … rājā … coraṃ gahetvā hanati vā bandhati vā ~eti vā ti; Sp 297, 20 foll.: raṭṭhato nikkhāmeti); D III 92, 29 (sammā ~etabbaṃ ~eyya); A III 366, 22 (upāsakānaṃ etad ahosi … yannūna mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Dhammikaṃ ~eyyāmā ti); Ja V 470, 18 (raṭṭhato naṃ ~ehī ti); VI 491, 22* (raṭṭhā ~ayantu taṃ); Ap 94, 22 (sā kaññā putte ~ayissati); Cp 3:2:9 (ghātāpemi tuvaṃ ajja raṭṭhā ~ayāmi vā); — part.pr. ( a ) pabbājaya(t), mfn. , Dhp 388 (~ayam attano malaṃ tasmā pabbajito ti vuccati); Sp 999, 26 (~ayato); ( b ) pabbājenta, mfn. , Ja VI 499, 19´ ; Dhp-a II 55, 13 (~entā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~etvā); IV 145, 13 (~ento, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~ayanto); — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) pabbājetvā, Vin I 97, 26 ; Ja V 193, 13 ; Mil 110, 6 (Devadattaṃ bhagavā yogaññutāya ~etvā); Vism 387, 33 ; Bv-a 19, 32 (te pi sabbe ehibhikkhupabbajjāya ~etvā); ( b ) pabbājetvāna, Th 477; — pass. part.pr. pabbājiyamāna, mfn. , Sp 1010, 35 (attano pitarā putte ~iyamāne); Th-a II 250, 32 ; — pp pabbājita, mfn. , 1. admitted as a homeless ascetic; formally admitted to the Buddhist saṅgha; Vin I 43, 12 (idāni anena jaṭilasahassaṃ ~itaṃ); M II 62, 1 (imehi muṇḍakehi samaṇakehi amhākaṃ ekaputtako piyo manāpo ~ito ti); 123, 13 (te tathā ~itā, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Se pabbajitā); Mil 107, 27 (bhante Nāgasena Devadatto kena ~ito ti); — 2. banished; expelled; sent away; D I 92, 19 (te raṭṭhasmā ~itā); A III 368, 7 ; Ja III 17, 5* (sakā raṭṭhā ~ito aññaṃ janapadaṃ gato, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pabbajito, prob. wr ) quoted Sadd 344, 27 ( Be so; Ee pabbajito); Ja VI 138, 18* (api raṭṭhā ~itā); 561, 23´ (mama raṭṭhā ~itāya araññe vasantiyā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pabbajitāya); Ap 94, 23 (~itā ca te sabbe, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pabbajitvā, prob. wr ); Dhp-a IV 145, 4 (kilesamalānaṃ pana ~itattā pabbajito nāma hotī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se pabbajitattā) ≠ Pv-a 146, 14 ( Be, Ce, Ee pabbajitattā); — pabbājitassā ti in Ee at M III 125, 6 is wr for pabbajitassā ti ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — neg. apabbājita, mfn. , Sv 478, 29 (malassa apabbājitattā); — fpp ( a ) pabbājetabba, mfn. and n. impers. , Vin I 22, 11 (evaṃ ca pana bhikkhave ~etabbo upasampādetabbo); 73, 19 (na bhikkhave pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭho ~etabbo, yo ~eyya āpatti dukkaṭassā ti); V 139, 32 (dasavassena bhikkhunā … ~etabbaṃ upasampādetabbaṃ); Mil 246, 16 (yadā apunarāvattī hoti tadā so ~etabbo); ( b ) pabbājetāya, mfn. , M I 231, 3 (vatteyya rañño … vaso ghātetāyaṃ vā ghātetuṃ … ~etāyaṃ vā ~etuṃ; Ps II 277, 3 : sakaraṭṭhato pabbājanārahaṃ ~etuṃ nīharituṃ); ( c ) pabbājanīya 1 , mfn. , Mil 186, 9 (daṇḍanīyo daṇḍetabbo ~anīyo pabbājetabbo bandhanīyo bandhitabbo, Be, Ce so; Ee ~aniyo; Se pabbajānīyo); Ja III 70, 2´ (raṭṭhā ~anīyasaṅkhātaṃ vyasanaṃ patto, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pabbājana-); Mhv 18:18 (~anīyā ca bahu); — caus. ( b ) pr. 3 sg. pabbajāpeti ( and pabbajjāpeti ?), causes someone to admit someone to the saṅgha; causes someone to be admitted to the saṅgha; — aor. 3 sg. pabbajāpesi, Mp I 328, 21 (satthā imaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sādarena ~esi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ādarena pabbajjāpesi); Dhp-a II 225, 6 (tena hi maṃ pabbājethā ti, thero bhikkhunīnaṃ ācikkhitvā ~esi, Se so; Be pabbājesi; Ce pabbajjāpesi; Ee pabbājāpesi); Mhv 5:197 (yo tu puttaṃ dhītaraṃ vā pabbajjāpesi sāsane; ≠ Dīp 7:17: pabbājesi); — pp pabbajāpita, mfn. , Dhp-a I 72, 13 (tvaṃ kaṃ āpucchitvā pabbajito kena ~ito si, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee pabbajito si); — see also pavajati.

[ပ+ဝဇ+ဏေ+ယု]
（၁） ထွက်သွားစေခြင်း။ （က） နှင်ထုတ်ခြင်း။ （ခ） ပယ်ဖျောက်ခြင်း။ （ဂ） ငြိမ်းအေးစေခြင်း။ （၂） လူ့ဘောင်မှ-ထွက်မြောက်-ဖဲခွါ-စေခြင်း၊ သာသနာ့ဘောင်၌ ဝင်ရောက်စေခြင်း။ （က） ရှင်-သာမဏေ-ပြုပေးခြင်း။ （ခ） ရဟန်း-ပဉ္စင်း-ပြုပေးခြင်း။ （၃） ထွက်သွားစေ-နှင်ထုတ်-ရာ（အခါ）။ ပဗ္ဗာဇနကာလ-ကြည့်။

DOP: pabbajana n. [ cf S. pravrajana], leaving home to live the life of a homeless ascetic; Th-a I 234, 10 (dukkhaṃ ~aṃ dukkarā pabbajjā ti duppabbajjaṃ); Cp-a 195, 16 (rājissariyaṃ … chaḍḍetvā katthaci alaggacittena hutvā ~aṃ); Mhv 30:79 (dhammacakkappavattiṃ ca Yasapabbajanaṃ pi ca); — apabbajana , n. , not leaving home; not giving up worldly life; Ja III 393, 29 (idāni ’ssa ~’-atthāya sarīravaṇṇaṃ vaṇṇessāmī ti); IV 475, 27 (~-kāraṇaṃ).

pabbājana n. , ~ā, f. , 1. [ S. pravrājana], expulsion; banishment; D I 135, 14 (ahaṃ etaṃ dassukhīlaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā ~āya vā samūhanissāmī ti; Sv 296, 21 : raṭṭhato nīharaṇena); III 93, 26 (daṇḍādānaṃ paññāyissati ~aṃ paññāyissati); A I 201, 26 (yad … dukkhaṃ upadahati vadhena vā … ~āya vā); Mil 357, 14 ; Dhp-a IV 145, 14 (yo attano rāgādimalaṃ pabbājento … carati so pi tena ~ena pabbajito ti vuccatī ti); — 2. formally admitting to the Buddhist saṅgha; Vism 312, 22 (so °’-atthāya sīmaṃ nīto); Mp I 247, 16 (bhante ~am eva tumhākaṃ bhāro).
